body:
Exposure triage: **published crates.io 0.8.0+b3c5efc7… exposes this.** On main 6e0dffd37e04b01b80dc56eb833b00fc337b6873, `Stream::open` is public, safe and doc-hidden; its comment names the C API, which no longer calls it on main either. Released Rust callers can therefore compile the same forget-and-free pattern. Whether a point release or advisory is warranted is your call; I have made no release, yank or advisory.

— Sam Shackleton
